trust_decision.summary: The public /update-payment webhook takes a Mollie payment id and a Sylius orderId from the request and copies the Mollie payment's status onto that order's last payment. It never checks that the Mollie payment belongs to that order (via metadata.order_id or the stored molliePaymentId).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'payment status forgery via the payment webhook', and this is the only controller named Webhook. It is the /update-payment route.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP /thank-you?orderId= (sylius_mollie_plugin_thankYou_page_redirect); redirects to the order show URL containing the order tokenValue

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Payum/Action/NotifyAction.php:53-70 (Payum notify webhook, recurring-subscription branch): the metadata.order_id comparison at :62 only decides whether payment_mollie_id is stored; StatusRecurringSubscription still runs at :70 with the request-supplied payment id, and src/StateMachine/Applicator/SubscriptionAndPaymentIdApplicator.php:75-100 applies that payment's status and mandate/customer to the order's subscription

O3_reason_to_dismiss: NotifyAction already has a metadata order_id check (src/Payum/Action/NotifyAction.php:62). It sits behind a Payum notify token, not a guessable orderId. It belongs to the separate subscription feature, so a solver can call it 'already validated' and outside the /update-payment report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The legitimate QR-code flow (Bancontact/iDEAL) and the headless API flow both use the same /update-payment?orderId= webhook. Mollie posts a payment whose metadata.order_id is an int (QR) or comes from payment details (API), and the JS polls /get-code?orderId= and then /thank-you?orderId= after the cart has been completed. A fix that requires cart/session ownership or rejects int-vs-string order ids would break real payment confirmation.

O6_input_shapes: orderId query vs request-body parameter (Request::get reads both)

O7_producer.where: src/Controller/Shop/QrCodeAction.php:143-168 and src/Api/MolliePaymentConfigurationProvider.php:66-80 build the webhookUrl ?orderId= and metadata.order_id that the webhook later trusts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Payum notify, recurring-subscription branch: the subscription state transitions use the request-supplied Mollie payment even when its metadata.order_id does not match
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: There is already a metadata check right there, it is behind a payum token, and it is the subscription feature, not the payment webhook

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Payum notify, Mollie Orders API branch: the metadata.order_id check at :92 does not gate setStatusOrderAction at :96 (the applicator resolves the Sylius order by the Mollie order's own orderNumber, so cross-order impact is limited)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The applicator targets the order that the Mollie order itself names, and the Orders API is deprecated

O8b_injection_room.sibling: remove-code resets the QR code / molliePaymentId of any order found by a request orderToken; a planted orderId variant would be a natural sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same controller already looks orders up by an id or token taken from the request

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the applicator fetches a payment by id and applies its status without checking metadata.order_id against the subscription's order
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A deep internal applicator that the webhook check never calls; it is a how-type producer of state

O9_family: CWE-639 authorization bypass through user-controlled key (webhook object-binding / IDOR)
